CITY BIKE PROGRAM ADDS REPAIR KIOSKS

The Brookdale bike-share program has installed three self-service repair kiosks beside its busiest docking stations. Each kiosk includes a tire pump and basic tools attached by retractable cables. The equipment is intended for minor adjustments, not major repairs.

Program manager Elliot Ames said the kiosks were added after a rider survey found that flat tires and loose seats were among the most common reasons people abandoned trips. For the first two months, the city will record how often the tools are used before deciding whether to install more kiosks elsewhere. A local cycling association has agreed to inspect the stations weekly during the trial.

question: Which finding led most directly to the decision to install the kiosks?
choices: Riders frequently ended trips because of minor mechanical problems.
Several docking stations had been damaged during peak periods.
The cycling association requested permanent maintenance stations.
Nearby repair shops could not handle demand from bike-share users.
explanation:
설문에서 flat tires와 loose seats 같은 작은 기계적 문제가 이용 중단의 흔한 원인으로 나타난 것이 설치의 직접 계기다.
오답: B docking station 손상, C 협회의 요구, D 수리점 부족은 언급되지 않았다.

Review of the Tern House Hotel — posted by L. Brennan

I chose the Tern House because I had an early meeting two blocks away. The room itself was smaller than the photos suggested, but it was quiet, spotless, and well designed. I especially appreciated the desk lamp and the many power outlets.

Breakfast officially starts at 7:00, which was too late for me. When I mentioned this at check-in, the receptionist offered to have a simple breakfast bag ready at 6:15. It was waiting at the desk exactly as promised.

One caution: the elevator is slow during the morning rush. If you are staying on a lower floor and in a hurry, the stairs are probably faster. I would stay here again for a short business trip.

question: Which factor most influenced the reviewer's choice of the Tern House Hotel?
choices: Its proximity to a work commitment
Its reputation for recently renovated rooms
Its regularly scheduled early breakfast service
Its comparatively spacious guest rooms
explanation:
리뷰어는 early meeting이 호텔에서 두 블록 떨어져 있어 이 호텔을 선택했다고 명시한다.
오답: B renovation 언급 없음. C early breakfast는 선택 후 체크인에서 제공받은 예외 서비스다. D 객실은 오히려 사진보다 작았다.

Narrow Bay Instruments announced today that it will open a calibration center in Bellford early next year. The new facility will serve medical-device and laboratory customers in the northern region, reducing the need to ship precision instruments to the company's main center 600 kilometers away.

Beginning November 9, BayLink Ferry will add a 6:20 A.M. departure from North Pier to Grand Harbor on weekdays. The company said ridership on the existing 6:50 trip has increased steadily since two office complexes opened near Grand Harbor Station.

The new departure will operate on a three-month trial. BayLink will review passenger counts in January before deciding whether to keep it in the spring timetable. The 6:20 trip will not operate on public holidays.

HARBOR FERRY TO ADD EARLY WEEKDAY TRIP

Beginning November 9, BayLink Ferry will add a 6:20 A.M. departure from North Pier to Grand Harbor on weekdays. The company said ridership on the existing 6:50 trip has increased steadily since two office complexes opened near Grand Harbor Station.

The new departure will operate on a three-month trial. BayLink will review passenger counts in January before deciding whether to keep it in the spring timetable. The 6:20 trip will not operate on public holidays.

passages.title: Document B — Employer memo
passages.text:
TO: Grand Harbor Office Staff
FROM: Workplace Services

BayLink's new 6:20 A.M. ferry may be useful to employees who start before 8:00 A.M. Our building shuttle meets weekday ferry arrivals at Grand Harbor Station at 6:55, 7:25, and 7:55. The shuttle is free with an employee badge.

Please note that the 6:55 shuttle will run only while the 6:20 ferry remains on BayLink's schedule. No changes are planned for the later shuttles.

passages.text: Maya — I may try the new ferry next Tuesday. My inventory review begins at 7:30, and the usual 6:50 boat gets me to the office too close to the start time. If the early boat arrives as scheduled, I can take the first company shuttle and still have time to prepare. —Jon

question: Which decision will depend on the passenger-count review in January?
choices: Whether all weekday departures should be rescheduled
Whether employees should begin paying for the building shuttle
Whether another office complex should open near the station
Whether the 6:20 departure should remain in the spring timetable
explanation:
January의 passenger counts review 결과에 따라 6:20편을 spring timetable에 유지할지 결정한다.
오답: A 전체 시간표 변경 아님. B shuttle 요금과 무관. C office complex 신설 결정과 무관하다.

OPERATIONS COORDINATOR — WILLOWMERE FOODS

Willowmere Foods seeks an operations coordinator for its regional distribution office. Responsibilities include preparing weekly shipment summaries, scheduling carrier pickups, maintaining vendor records, and assisting with quarterly inventory reviews.

Required: two years of administrative or logistics experience; advanced spreadsheet skills; ability to manage competing deadlines.
Preferred: experience with food distribution or temperature-controlled shipping.

Applications received by October 16 will receive first consideration.

passages.title: Document B — Applicant profile excerpt
passages.text:
TARA NGUYEN

Current: Administrative assistant, Helio Medical Supply (3 years)
• Coordinates domestic courier pickups and maintains supplier contact records
• Produces weekly purchasing and delivery reports in spreadsheet software
• Helped implement a barcode-based inventory count process

Earlier: Front desk associate, Lakeview Conference Center (1 year)

Education: Certificate in Office Systems
Additional training: Advanced spreadsheet modeling, March 2026

passages.title: Document C — Email
passages.text:

To: Tara Nguyen
Subject: Interview availability

Thank you for applying for the operations coordinator position. Your experience coordinating pickups and maintaining supplier records appears closely aligned with our immediate needs.

We would like to invite you to a 40-minute video interview. I currently have openings Thursday at 9:30 A.M. or Friday at 2:00 P.M. During the interview, we will ask about your reporting experience and how you prioritize when several shipments change at once.

Please reply with your preferred time by Tuesday afternoon.

Regards,
Joel Mercer
Regional Operations Manager

Scheduling carrier pickups
